size_t
  audio_resample_stereo (audio_resampler_t * state, const float * input,
  size_t frames, double input_rate, float * output, size_t capacity, double
  output_rate)


Stateful interleaved resampling; capacities and return value are
    frames. Invalid arguments return zero and set ERROR_INVALID_PARAM. On
    insufficient capacity the state and output are left unchanged.

asciichat_error_t audio_route_capture (const float *
  input, size_t frames, unsigned channels, int first_channel, unsigned
  selected_channels, float * output)


Internal PCM is interleaved stereo. PCM sample counts include both
    channels. Route a zero-based mono input or adjacent stereo pair to internal
    PCM. A negative first_channel downmixes all input channels to centered mono.
    Input and output must not overlap. No allocation or locking is
  performed.
